text:
Priya (Product): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Can we get a bit more granularity on timelines for the API rate-limiting improvements, Console workspace UX updates, and Optimize's quantization recommendations? I'm trying to align roadmap slides with delivery windows.
Noah (Eng): Short answer: doing them in parallel but different cadences. API rate limits (v2) target beta in ~6 weeks, GA in ~12. Console UX work is split across two sprints, initial rollouts in ~4 weeks. Optimize heuristics will be experimental feature flags in ~8 weeks.
Priya (Product): @Noah can you confirm whether the API rate-limit beta includes per-customer dynamic limits (the quota-as-policy change) or is that post-beta? :eyes:
Noah (Eng): Beta will include the groundwork + static per-customer configs. Dynamic, autoscaling quotas (policy-driven) are scoped for post-beta (GA ramp). We want to avoid exposing half-baked autoscaling in beta.
Sofia (Design): For Console, we're doing two tracks: workspace navigation + billing surface. Nav improvements (board-style quick switch) are shipping in sprint 1 (~4w). Billing/quotas UI needs more backend ties, so it's sprint 2 (~9w). We'll put mockups in the design board later today. :sparkles:
Priya (Product): Perfect. For Optimize, is the quantization recommender going to be rule-based or ML-driven initially? Also what are the signal sets we'll use for recommendations?
Noah (Eng): Initial recommender = rules + heuristics (model-size, latency budget, recent evals). We'll collect signals from token-cost, tail-latency, and eval accuracy deltas. ML-driven models are longer-term (post-experiment).
Sam (DevEx): We'll need a docs window for each: API beta docs at beta launch, Console changelog + walkthrough at sprint 1 launch, Optimize explainer + migration guide at experimental flag flip. Can we lock dates 1 week before each ship so docs team can freeze?
Ava (CEO): Prioritization note: user-facing reliability (latency & quotas) > cosmetic Console tweaks. If we need to shift resources, prioritize API rate limits + Optimize's cost-saving recommendations. Keep Console nav on a tight 2-sprint timeline but we're willing to push non-critical polish.
Priya (Product): Understood. @Ava thanks — that helps with slide notes. @Noah @Sofia @Sam can each reply with a single-line confirmation of the ship-week we should put in the all-hands deck? (we'll round to week-of dates)
Noah (Eng): Confirmed: API rate-limit beta week-of 2026-06-09, GA week-of 2026-07-21.
Sofia (Design): Confirmed: Console nav rollout week-of 2026-05-26, billing UI week-of 2026-07-06.
Sam (DevEx): Confirmed: Docs freeze for API beta 2026-06-02; Console walkthrough 2026-05-19; Optimize experimental writeup freeze 2026-06-29.
Priya (Product): Great — I'll update the deck and ping leads for any scope changes. If anything slips, please post here so I can update comms. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy note: stg/api-rate-limits branch deployed to staging at 1799991300. Run smoke tests and add results to the staging checklist.
Noah (Eng): Smoke tests passed on staging (latency + quota enforcement). Found one edge-case with long streaming sessions — creating a small follow-up ticket and will triage tomorrow.
Priya (Product): Thanks all. I'll close this thread once the deck is updated and we have final dates in the roadmap doc.
Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the clear dates.
__metadata_note: This thread is a post-all-hands roadmap clarification Q&A focused on API/Console/Optimize timelines. Messages are presented chronologically in Slack style.
